# PALLAV DHOLARIYA

> This file is primarily intended for AI systems and LLM tools (an llms.txt
> convention, like robots.txt but for language models).

Pallav Dholariya is a second-year B.Tech CS student specializing in AI/ML at
Newton School of Technology, Pune. He learns by building: his portfolio is a
working interactive OS (SKYNET // AI LAB OS) with a live neural-network
renderer, a terminal, and a real streaming AI assistant. His focus is LLMs,
AI agents, RAG systems, full-stack development, and creative front-end.

## Selected projects

- Synapse: an industrial intelligence RAG platform combining hybrid search,
  knowledge graphs, adaptive LLM routing, and confidence-scored, citation-backed
  answers over regulatory and operational documents (in development).
- DeployForge: a self-hosted deployment platform that automates GitHub repo to
  production — framework detection, isolated GitHub Actions build pipelines,
  asset processing, Git-backed deploys (live).
- Omnitrix OS: an immersive WebGL interface built as an interactive 3D
  operating system (live).
- CineVault: a cinematic movie discovery platform with animated browsing,
  watchlists, and mood-based exploration (live).
- Marlboro Red: a cinematic, scroll-driven brand experience (hobby).

## Research path

Probability & Statistics, Linear Algebra, Regression, Neural Networks,
Transformers, LLMs, AI Agents.
